tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Screen ground.

tokens.name: fog-raised
tokens.usage: Terrace faces: cards, inputs, secondary buttons, the bottom bar.

tokens.name: ledge
tokens.usage: The stepped underside of a terrace, pressed and disabled fills. Decorative depth only.

tokens.name: rib
tokens.usage: Row rules, control outlines and the divider inside a Window plate. 3:1 or better on fog and fog-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on fog, fog-raised and ledge.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels above figures, availability, unselected tabs. On fog and fog-raised.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The silhouette as an action: primary button, selected chip or time, active tab edge, current step, switch-on, the top edge of the key card.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action.

tokens.name: banner
tokens.usage: The one faded red: live status, count badges, errors, expiry warnings. One red thing per screen.

tokens.name: on-banner
tokens.usage: Text on a banner fill.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen title, uppercase. It stands alone: no kicker line above it.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The number a screen exists for (ticket, window). Always under a label, never inline in a sentence.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Times in a Timetable, dates in a notice row.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Row and card titles. One line of meaning; no subtitle unless it changes a decision.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text. One sentence per card where possible.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, field labels, the label above a figure, nav. Uppercase.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Nav labels and the month under a date. Uppercase. Never sentences.

styles.name: reading-small
styles.sample: It was a bright cold day in April.
styles.usage: Book text in the EPUB and TXT reader at the size the reader picks. Book headings are 4/3 (h1, h2) or 9/8 (h3 to h6) of it at 600.

styles.name: reading-medium
styles.sample: It was a bright cold day in April.
styles.usage: Book text in the EPUB and TXT reader at the size the reader picks. Book headings are 4/3 (h1, h2) or 9/8 (h3 to h6) of it at 600.

styles.name: reading-large
styles.sample: It was a bright cold day in April.
styles.usage: Book text in the EPUB and TXT reader at the size the reader picks. Book headings are 4/3 (h1, h2) or 9/8 (h3 to h6) of it at 600.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal button padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between content groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Air above a monumental title.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything by default.

tokens.name: radius-sweep
tokens.usage: The sweep: one long curved corner of one block per screen (bottom-right of the key card).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Step markers, the FAB, the switch knob, status dots.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom bar height, excluding the gesture inset. Slim: icon plus one label line.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: One-line list rows and timetable rows.

tokens.name: stroke-trim
tokens.usage: The action-coloured edge along the top of the key card and the active tab.

tokens.name: ledge-step
tokens.usage: How far a terrace ledge steps out below its face.

tokens.name: plate-width
tokens.usage: Width of a Window plate, divider included.
